column3: of the fire god (Agni) and others
the speech of the group of sages
at that very time he, the source of unrighteousness, followed here
with the lives given by him
I, (am) he by whom the broken dams were rivers
of the man of that continent
marked by the glory of his valour
all that is only the subtle element
root of that, unmanifest, of unfathomable depth
he will see him in the fire
by his sons, by eyes, by the inner self
with raised sword said to him this
the pleased brahmanas said to him
the three worlds of the two
is shaking? (a word of the Odia text; unclear)
they will cross, thus he went
in that forest empty of men
I, with the marks of lotus, thunderbolt, goad and banner
with betel, rest, fanning, scents and garlands
without distinctions of higher and lower
we stay here today until then
with sesame, cows, land and gold
of the one of holy fame
under pretext of visiting holy places
dusty-grey all around with the dust of horses
third, the creation of the sages
by that he reaches the Self by the Self
they, with unblinking eyes, followed him with their minds
in the three worlds by them
I am eager to give up here
also giving up and so on
thirteenth day of the lunar fortnight
the blessings of the gods, thrice (three tens)
the teacher of the three worlds
at the end of three nights
from the three folds (on the belly)
of the dwellers of heaven too
you are the friend of unrighteousness
know yourself by the Self, of unfailing sight
you are the beginning and the end
you, the Self, the self-born one's own
you, who are found by the poor
you, with bow and arrows in hand
that adorable (splendour) of Savitr (Gayatri mantra line)
trembling stamens? (a group of anthers; shaky)
in the daughter of Daksha was born
like one with a raised staff in hand
given and enjoyed by the needy
of the words about churning curd
in the form of curd churning and so on
with curd, unbroken rice, fruit and sugarcane
by sight, touch, talk, lying, sitting and eating together
the Dahara vidya (knowledge of the small space in the heart) and so on
you are the salvation of the burning
when the body is burning with fires
toward the self-controlled, the unattached, the compliant
surpassing the wealth of the heaven-world with joys of the senses
like a god fallen from heaven
divine herbs, juices, elixirs, food, drink, baths, and mental pains
of the performers of the long sacrifice
silk garment, bracelets and so on
with a mind stricken by sorrow
of those repeatedly tormented in spirit by sorrows
O brahmanas, milk this earth's herbs, by that
the chains of the hard-to-escape home
like an unfortunate woman now abandoned
in the form of evil planets
this dwelling in evil state in the Self
having seen the sage following his son, who was not naked
having seen, said to his younger brother
assuming the form of Devaki's son
of the gods and the rest
among gods, animals, men and others
having attained the state of a divine sage
when the god does not rain
in the house of the body
the body whose beginning and end are unmanifest
body discoloration, bad smell, sweat, fatigue and weariness
in the body and so on
worshipped by the daityas and danavas
teaching the sons of the daitya
by fate, which cannot be warded off
provided with milking pots and so on
the wheel of dharma (first letters lost)
he deserves to be seen here
burnt by the weapon of Drona's son
by the teaching of the best brahmana
whose seat is two parardhas (the lifetime of Brahma)
a dyad (a combination of two atoms)
dharma and so on, and the goals
(they) bore the lotus feet of Vaikuntha
attentiveness toward brahmanas, gods and cows
state of mind, juice (rasa), hair on the body
the bearer, ox of the yoke
smoke, from that fire, the three Vedas
steadied the mind on the Lord
took up the chariot wheel and rushed, moving
in the Self-meditation? (adhyatma, relating to the Self)
with the flow of qualities destroyed
with the fruit of the qualities of maya destroyed
with the impurity of rajas, sattva and tamas destroyed
one should not cut nails and hair
by grandsons (of Drupada), Trigarta, Shala, Saindhava, Bahlika and others
of the sky and the rest
descended in the world of men
thicket of reeds, bamboo, arrow-grass, kusha grass and bamboo
in the opening of the butter pot
an unfit woman not to be approached
Nageshvara (Lord of serpents) / cobra saffron tree
he is not for the sake of himself
various lineages of the sages' families
did not follow, mother of a hero
from the lotus in the navel-lake Brahma arose
the names of the Endless One
